intro: The Forest's Bounty is a local quest in Shadowgale Forest where a timid forager asks for help collecting fallen acorns. Fierce predatory raptor-birds prowl the deeper woods, making harvesting too perilous without an adventurer's protection. The gathered acorns are then roasted into a tasty forest meal.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!
So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Mmm, I think you are going to like what I can cook up with these acorns!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, stranger! You'll find that these are delicious once roasted!
Please excuse me, it won't take me long to whip this up.
